- Site: Gate 33. Marcus posted this in #north-team on 14 Oct.
- Deadline: 22 November. Dana posted this in #north-random on 14 Oct and said there's nothing to do yet.
- Contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals: Thea Ramaswell, Quarrendon's Director of Yard Operations. She reported the problem: on the morning shift, the same trailer was checked in twice, once at the kiosk and once by dispatch by hand. Dana passed it on in #north-team. Dana Okafor is our account manager for Quarrendon.

I told Ilse that nothing I could see connects Thea to the Marlowe rollout itself; she's only the contact for the door 6 issue. I left out the seat counts from that #north-team thread because Ilse didn't ask for them. No approvals were needed and no mail was sent.
